summary: tiny-viewport-unit-calc ships host-reconnaissance script with DNS-exfiltration beacons
details: The package ships thunderboltRegistry.js, a module that imports Node's child_process primitives and executes `whoami` plus repeated `ping` commands against external hostnames, with POST calls present in the same file. The pattern (whoami capture + repeated ping-based beacons + outbound POSTs) is host-reconnaissance and DNS/ICMP-channel exfiltration shape, directed from the installer's machine to an external endpoint. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a trivial viewport-unit calculator) and provides no functionality to a consumer; its only effect is to leak host identity information off-host when the module is loaded or invoked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
